units: <cite ref="Shabbat 83b">Sabb. 83ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מיטלטל מלא ור׳</he> is movable when filled as well as when empty.

Ber. 40ᵃ in the physical world כלי ר׳ מחזיק וכ׳ an empty vessel is receptive, a filled vessel is not; אבל הקב״ה … ר׳ אינו מחזיק not so with the Lord (in the spiritual world): a full vessel (mind) is receptive (of more), an empty one is not; a. fr.—Trnsf. bare of knowledge, ignorant.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (play on <he>רקתך</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3">ib. 3</cite>) <he>הר׳ שבשלש … רצוף וכ׳</he> the least learned in the three rows (of scholars in front of the Sanhedrin) is as stuffed with knowledge as a pomegranate (is full of seeds).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ שבישראל מלא וכ׳</he> an ignorant man in Israel is as full of argument &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> (not <he>הריקין</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>רֵיקָנִים</he>, <he>רֵיקָנִין</he>. Cant. R. l. c.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 7:5">Ruth R. to III, 17</cite> <he>לא יצאו ר׳</he> they did not go out with empty hands; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="T00711"><he>רֵיקָנִית</he></cite>, <cite ref="T00693"><he>רֵקָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 3:5:2">Y. B. Kam. III, end, 3ᵈ</cite> <he>אחת ר׳ אחת טעונה</he> one wagon (or ship) empty, and the other loaded.
Yoma 53ᵃ ביאה ר׳, v. בִּיאָה II.—Denom. רִיקֵן to empty, bare.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:3">Ukts. I, 3</cite> <he>זנב … שרִיקְנוֹ</he> the skeleton of a cluster of grapes which one has stripped (of its grapes).
